label: Software Consulting Services Agreement for review
subject: Action Required: Software Consulting Services Agreement – Please Review and Sign
body:
Dear Mr. Alvarez,

Please find enclosed for your review the Software Consulting Services Agreement between TechStart Solutions LLC and DataBridge Consulting, Inc.

Key Terms:
Contract Title: Software Consulting Services Agreement
Parties: TechStart Solutions LLC (Client) and DataBridge Consulting, Inc. (Consultant)
Effective Date: May 1, 2026
Contract Term: Twelve (12) months
Expiration Date: April 30, 2027
Scope: The Consultant will provide software development services including architecture design, backend development, API integration, and technical advisory services as detailed in the attached Statement of Work.
Compensation: $12,500 per month, invoiced on the first of each month.

This agreement has been reviewed by our in-house legal team and is ready for execution. Please review all terms carefully with your own legal counsel before signing. If you have any questions, require modifications, or wish to schedule a call to discuss the agreement, please contact our legal team at contracts@techstart.io or (628) 555-0202.

We look forward to a successful partnership.

TechStart Solutions LLC
Legal & Contracts Team
contracts@techstart.io
